what_it_does: The Passage M1000 is a 3D photonic interposer—essentially a thin silicon layer with integrated optics—that replaces electrical wires between AI accelerator chips and their memory. Instead of sending electrical signals through copper traces (which are slow and energy-hungry), the interposer converts data to light, uses different wavelengths to send many signals simultaneously through the same glass fiber, and converts them back to electricity on the other end. This approach offers dramatically higher bandwidth density and lower power consumption compared to traditional electrical connections between chiplets.
